margen.superficie: the unlit brick wall of the warehouse, its mortar lines running evenly

escena: SCENE (a set being rigged, warehouse in Mexico City, late afternoon, NO recognisable faces): the steel rail crosses the RIGHT half of the frame in a hard diagonal, sharp along its whole length, and a technician works behind it at the instant they lock a clamp. A hard low sun beam comes in from the right and lights them and the dust in the air; the reserved brick wall down the left side stays in its own even shadow, with nothing crossing it. A large AZURE-BLUE lighting panel stands lit in the right background. An ORANGE strip of marking tape runs along the floor at the right edge. 35mm at f/4. Everything is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a matte black flight case at the bottom of the frame
